title: WakeMark MCP
description: Connect WakeMark to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP-compatible agent. Setup guide, client configs and tool reference.

hero.title: WakeMark MCP Server
hero.subtitle: Give AI agents secure access to your X bookmarks through the Model Context Protocol. Search, read, organize and semantically query your bookmarks from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and more.

overview.title: Overview
overview.p1: WakeMark exposes a remote MCP server over Streamable HTTP. Instead of running anything locally, your MCP client connects straight to your WakeMark account using an API key.

points.auth: Authentication: API key via Authorization header (Bearer token)
points.scope: Scope: your bookmarks, tags, Lists and read state — nothing else

quickstart.title: Quickstart
quickstart.step1Body: Open Dashboard > MCP and create a key. Copy it immediately — it is only shown once.
quickstart.step2Title: Add the server to your client
quickstart.step2Body: Paste the config for your client from the section below, replacing the placeholder with your key.
quickstart.step3Body: Try: "What did I bookmark about design systems this month?" or "Summarize my unread bookmarks."

limits.title: Rate limits & quotas
limits.body: Each API key allows 120 requests per minute. When the limit is reached, requests are rejected with a rate-limit error until the window resets. ask_bookmarks additionally shares your account's AI usage limits.

security.title: Security notes
security.p1: An API key grants full MCP access to your WakeMark data. Never commit keys to a repository or share them publicly.

points.revoke: Revoke a compromised key immediately from Dashboard > MCP — access stops instantly.
points.expiry: Prefer keys with an expiration date for short-lived experiments.
points.storage: Keys are stored hashed; the plaintext value is shown exactly once at creation time.

faq.title: Troubleshooting
faq.a1: Check that the Authorization header is exactly 'Bearer ' followed by the full key (wkm_...). Keys are shown only once; if you lost it, revoke it and create a new one.
faq.q2: Requests fail with a rate-limit error
faq.a2: You exceeded 120 requests per minute for this key. Wait for the window to reset, or reduce tool-call frequency in your agent.
faq.q3: How do I verify the connection works?
faq.a4: Bookmarks come from your connected X account. Make sure X sync is set up in the dashboard and that at least one sync has completed.
